title: Tutorials and guides
subtitle: A short video for students and slides for teachers, for every app.

youModerate.title: You moderate
youModerate.description: Two characters debate a topic you choose. You run the debate: give the floor, ask questions, keep them on topic.

doppiaIntervista.title: Double interview
doppiaIntervista.description: Ask two characters the same questions and compare their answers, like a TV double interview.

convinciTu.title: Convince them
convinciTu.description: Pick an idea and try to win over a historical character. They only change their mind if your arguments hold up.

personaggioMisterioso.title: Mystery character
personaggioMisterioso.description: A character hides who they are. You get a few questions to find out, then you make your guess.

impersonaTu.title: Play the part
impersonaTu.description: Play a historical character while the AI plays another. It asks you questions to see how well you know your role.

wikiChatbot.title: WikiChat
wikiChatbot.description: Talk to a Wikipedia page: a person, place, event or idea answers you in the first person.

promptEngineer.title: Prompts for teaching
promptEngineer.description: For teachers and students: learn to write clear prompts to use AI in class.

teacherGuide.title: Teacher Guide
teacherGuide.description: A comprehensive guide on how to use our applications to create innovative and engaging learning experiences.

allApps.title: All Applications
allApps.description: View all available applications on a single page for a complete overview.

reddit.title: Reddit Community
reddit.description: Join our Reddit community to share experiences, ideas, and educational experiments with other educators.

step2.title: Read the tutorial
step2.description: To understand how to use it

forTeachers.title: For Teachers
forTeachers.description: Each application can be used to create engaging activities that transform traditional learning into interactive experiences.

forStudents.title: For Students
forStudents.description: Use these tools to explore history, practice debate, and develop critical thinking.

forEveryone.title: For Everyone
forEveryone.description: Experiment with different combinations of applications to create personalized learning paths.
